 New Music Stephen Wilson Jr. Announces Double Album, Earns Frank Black His First Grammy Nomination, Covers Oasis At Rock Hall
 TB By Tom Breihan 11:42 AM EST on November 16, 2026 
 Add Stereogum to Google Jace Kartye The world is suddenly very invested in you learning all about Stephen Wilson Jr., an Indiana-born country-rock singer-songwriter who is having a breakout year at the age of 47. In the past few days, Wilson has performed at the Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony, earned Pixies leader Frank Black his first-even Grammy nomination, announced a new double album, and released the Chris Stapleton duet that serves as that album's lead single. That's a lot of stuff! 
 Wilson, a former food scientist, didn't become a full-time musician until the age of 37, when he became staff songwriter for Nasville's Big Loud. He's married to Leigh Nash from Sixpence None The Richer. Wilson released his debut album søn of dad , inspired by the death of his father, in 2023, and he followed it with Blankets , a 2025 EP where he covered Nirvana, Temple Of The Dog, the Postal Service, and the Smashing Pumpkins. Back in September, Wilson and Eddie Vedder sang "Hunger Strike" together at Vedder's Ohana Fest.
 Wilson used to play in indie rock bands, and he refers to his sound as "Death Cab for country." He learned to play guitar by playing Soundgarden songs, and he has been covering Hum's "Stars" on tour. This week, he's up for four CMA Awards, including New Artist Of The Year and Song Of The Year, for his minor country radio hit " Gary ." The Grammy nominations came out this morning, and Wilson is up for two awards: Best Country Solo Performance, for "Gary," and Best Country Song, for "Hardwired." 
 "Hardwired," which features Miranda Lambert, interpolates the Pixies classic " Where Is My Mind ," and it credits Frank Black as a co-writer. (Wilson, Lambert, Telemitry, and Adam Hood are also credited as writers on that song, so they're all nominated, too.) Pixies were nominated for the Best Boxed Or Special Limited Edition Package Grammy in 2011, but that award goes to art directors, not artists. That means that Wilson's song "Hardwired" has earned Black his first-ever Grammy nomination.
 Oasis were inducted into the Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame on Saturday. As previously reported, they elected not to attend , and Liam Gallagher was pretty funny about it. Bob Odenkirk gave the band's induction speech, and Stephen Wilson Jr. was chosen to honor them with an entirely solo cover of "Wonderwall." On the red carpet, Stereogum's own Scott Lapatine spoke to Wilson about why that song isn't as easy to master as it might seem. He also got an "anyway, here's 'Wonderwall'" out of Wilson.
 Anyway, here's "Wonderwall."
 Backstage, Wilson said that he looked forward to the Gallaghers roasting him. But Liam liked it! Honestly! 
 I liked it honestly
— Liam Gallagher (@liamgallagher) November 15, 2026 No we don’t I just felt it had a real organic feel about and it brought out my melancholy side which I have hidden for security reasons
— Liam Gallagher (@liamgallagher) November 15, 2026 Given all the fuss suddenly surrounding Stephen Wilson Jr., it's obviously a great time for him to announce a new album. Early next year, he'll release the 20-track double LP Impressiøn Of A Human // Children Of The Cørnerman . Wilson co-produced the record with Ben West, and a press release says that it's "divided into two distinct albums, one looking warily at an increasingly technology-driven future, and the other trying to make sense of a hardscrabble past." Here's what Wilson says about it:
 When I was writing these songs, I was storytelling about a semi-dystopian hillbilly future. That’s Impressiøn Of A Human . And I was also storytelling about a semi-dystopian hillbilly past, which is Children Of The Cørnerman . That’s how the two titles came about. I wanted to approach this album as a literary artist, like the way Stephen King would release two books at the same time that are completely unique to each other but are also a holistic collection.
 "Gary" and "Hardwired," Wilson's two Grammy-nominated songs, both appear on the album. Wilson's new single "I'm A Song" is one that he wrote years ago; it was among his late father's favorites. Now, it's a duet with Chris Stapleton, and Wilson and Stapleton will perform it together at the CMA Awards on Wednesday. The same night, Wilson will also be a guest on Kimmel . Below, check out "I'm A Song," the Impressiøn Of A Human // Children Of The Cørnerman tracklist, and Wilson's upcoming tour dates.
